title: 報警 / 求助
description: 向警察或他人求助的用語

sentences.en: Please call the police!
I need help immediately.
Someone stole my bag.
I'd like to report a theft.
Officer, I need your help.
sentences.zh: 警察先生，我需要你的幫助。

sentences.en: I was robbed on the street.
Someone broke into my car.
I want to file a police report.
There's a suspicious person following me.
sentences.zh: 有個可疑的人在跟蹤我。

sentences.en: I've been scammed.
My credit card was used without my permission.
I witnessed a crime.
Someone is threatening me.
I need a copy of the police report.
Can you send an officer to this location?
sentences.zh: 你們能派一位警察到這個地點嗎？

sentences.en: I feel unsafe in this area.
sentences.zh: 我在這個區域覺得不安全。

sentences.en: My house was broken into.
I need to report a missing person.
sentences.zh: 我需要報告一個失蹤人口。

sentences.en: He snatched my phone and ran away.
sentences.zh: 他搶了我的手機就跑了。

sentences.en: I'd like to speak to a detective.
Can I get protection?
Where is the nearest police station?
I have evidence on my phone.
The incident happened about an hour ago.
sentences.zh: 事件大約一小時前發生的。

sentences.en: I can describe the suspect.
sentences.zh: 我可以描述嫌疑人的樣子。

sentences.en: Is there a translator available?
I need to contact my embassy.
sentences.zh: 我需要聯繫我的大使館。

sentences.en: Someone is harassing me.
I want to press charges.
Please help me, it's an emergency.
sentences.zh: 請幫幫我，這是緊急狀況。
